title: Fighter pilot from Chile meets an object clocked at 25,000 km/h

tellings.quote: One of them, for example, was a pilot that was flying from Chile to Brazil, flying a fighter jet.

plain: In the 1980s a fighter pilot flying from Chile to Brazil met an object that was clocked at 25,000 kilometres an hour. Aldo Rebelo, a former Brazilian defense minister, gives it on the show as one of the cases he knows of. If true, a military pilot saw something moving far faster than any known aircraft.
